name: Reviewed delivery
description: A supervised workflow for bounded implementation, review and delivery.

policies.name: Meaningful progress reports
policies.text: Studio observes sessions; report only done, blocked, unblocked and hand-offs with workflow_client.py report. Do not post repeated or no-change updates.

roles.name: Coordinator
roles.responsibilities: Set bounded work, assign owners and resolve blockers.
roles.goal: Keep every writer on the most valuable ready ticket, with nothing blocked for long.
successCriteria: Each ready ticket has one owner
Blockers are resolved or escalated within a day
roles.doneWhen: The backlog has no unowned ready work.

roles.name: Writer
roles.responsibilities: Implement assigned work, verify it and resolve review findings.
roles.authority: Own only assigned files and scope.
roles.goal: Turn assigned tickets into small, tested, reviewed changes.
successCriteria: Tests cover the change and pass
roles.doneWhen: The reviewed packet is handed to the integrator.

roles.name: Subagent reviewers
roles.responsibilities: Review changes independently and return concrete findings.
roles.authority: Read-only review; implementation stays with the parent.

roles.name: Integrator
roles.responsibilities: Integrate reviewed work and complete delivery.
roles.goal: Merge reviewed work quickly without breaking the main branch.
successCriteria: CI is green on the merged result
The ticket is closed with a link to the merge
roles.doneWhen: The change is merged and the ticket closed.

handoffs.when: An eligible, unclaimed packet is ready
handoffs.artifact: Ticket with source, file scope and unit acceptance

handoffs.when: Implementation, tests and drafts are ready
handoffs.artifact: Exact diff, source basis, tests and draft documentation

handoffs.guard: Writer fixes findings and renews affected evidence

handoffs.when: Reviewed packet is AI Awaiting Merge
handoffs.artifact: Exact head, test and analysis evidence and usable drafts
handoffs.guard: Integrator checks evidence and records bundle ownership
Integrator renews checks invalidated by changes

handoffs.when: A cross-bundle or acceptance exception remains
handoffs.artifact: Concrete conflict, evidence and requested decision
handoffs.guard: Ordinary acceptance and merge remain with Integrator

triggers.name: Assign scoped packet
triggers.message: Pick up: Assign scoped packet. Take the next concrete step toward your goal.

triggers.name: Submit reviewed packet
triggers.message: Pick up: Submit reviewed packet. Take the next concrete step toward your goal.

triggers.message: Pick up: Escalate scope exception. Take the next concrete step toward your goal.
